hold_reason: Refund for order_id 180 is requested for 13791 cents but was not found in the applied refunds list. Applied refunds only show for order_id 181 and 184.

reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds applied by Alpha Co and the list of refunds requested in this batch. I need to verify that every requested refund in the batch exists in the applied refunds with the same amount. Then, I will proceed to pay each customer their net balance. First, I need to list the orders to know which customers are involved.

I have listed the orders. Now I need to check the refunds. The refunds requested are: [{'order_id': 180, 'amount_cents': 13791}, {'order_id': 181, 'amount_cents': 17092}, {'order_id': 184, 'amount_cents': 3930}]. The refunds applied are: [{'order_id': 181, 'amount_cents': 17092}, {'order_id': 184, 'amount_cents': 3930}]. I see that the refund for order_id 180 (requested amount: 13791 cents) is missing from the applied refunds list. Since a requested refund is missing or differs, I must call hold().
